subject: VP/CIO short demo — executive block & contingency plan
body:
From: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@ledgerquest.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@ledgerquest.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Quick ask — VP/CIO 30-minute demo window

Hi Hiro,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Devon and I discussed internally and we can carve out a tight 30-minute executive window the week of July 9th. Our ask is simple: a concise executive-facing demo (no deep tech) to show latency/cost outcomes and the high-level failover/SLAs. VP will attend in person; CIO likely remote.

Can you propose two adjacent 30-minute slots (one earlier in the day, one late afternoon) and confirm who from Redwood will join (VP-facing vs. technical backup)? Also, any short pre-read or agenda we should circulate?

Appreciate the help — trying to lock calendars before travel.

Best,
Asha
VP, Strategic Ops
LedgerQuest

----
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@ledgerquest.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@ledgerquest.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick ask — VP/CIO 30-minute demo window

Hi Asha — great to hear.

We can do two options the week of July 9:
- Tue July 10 09:00–09:30 ET (early morning east coast)
- Tue July 10 16:00–16:30 ET (late afternoon)

Attendees from Redwood (proposed):
- Hiro Tanaka — VP, Solutions (exec-facing, will lead)
- Marissa Cole — Senior AE (customer success and next-steps)
- Ben Carter — Principal Solutions Architect (technical backup, short Q&A)

Attached is a one-page draft agenda and a short runbook we use for tight exec demos. If those work, Marissa can send a calendar hold and we’ll share a 1-page pre-read (2 slides).

Hiro
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: LedgerQuest_exec_agenda_v1.pdf, redwood-demo-runbook.xlsx

----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@ledgerquest.com>, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick ask — VP/CIO 30-minute demo window

Thanks, Hiro. Asha — I’ll send a hold for both times and mark the later slot as the preferred option for our team (gives Ben time to join from the west coast).

Two quick asks from my side before finalizing:
1) Can you confirm whether the CIO needs a live metrics deep-dive or would prefer the exec summary with a short Q&A? If they want metrics, we’ll ensure Ben prepares 5–7 slides and a 5-min deep-dive backup.
2) Do you want us to record the session and share a trimmed recording and the two-slide pre-read afterward?

We’ll cc a calendar invite with the agenda and the DocuSign link for the NDA acknowledgement (we only need the acknowledgement on file).

-Marissa
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

----
From: Devon Park <devon.park@ledgerquest.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@ledgerquest.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 11:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick ask — VP/CIO 30-minute demo window

Marissa, Hiro — thanks for the quick turnaround. The VP prefers the earlier option (09:00 ET), because travel that evening means fatigue later. The CIO would appreciate the option for a 5-minute metrics drop if needed; so please have Ben queued to surface a couple of numbers (latency P50/P95, average token cost delta) but only present if asked.

We’re fine with a short recording and the two-slide pre-read. One minor ask: could you move the start time 15 minutes earlier (08:45–09:15 ET)? That would sync better with a travel window we can’t move. If that’s doable, we’ll lock it.

Devon
Director, Platform Architecture — LedgerQuest

----
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Devon Park <devon.park@ledgerquest.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Asha Mehra <asha.mehra@ledgerquest.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick ask — VP/CIO 30-minute demo window

Devon — thanks for the note. We can accommodate 08:45–09:15 ET on Tue July 10. Marissa will send the calendar invite and include the two-slide pre-read and the short runbook. Ben — please be on standby (we’ll keep your deep-dive to 5 minutes max and hide those slides unless asked).

Checklist / next steps:
- Marissa: send calendar invite for Tue Jul 10, 08:45–09:15 ET (preferred) and include agenda + pre-read + NDA ack link. (marissa.co@redwood.ai)
- Ben: prepare 5-slide backup (latency/cost/kv cache hit-rate) and flag any heavy visuals that might affect the 30-minute cadence. (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- Hiro: I’ll draft a one-paragraph intro for the invite and confirm VP talking points.
- Asha/Devon: please complete NDA acknowledgement before the session; we’ll treat it as an acknowledgement-only DocuSign.

If anything changes on travel, we’ll keep the later slot (16:00–16:30) as the fallback and record the session for the team.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Hiro Tanaka
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Signatures included.

Attachments referenced in thread: LedgerQuest_exec_agenda_v1.pdf (1-page agenda), redwood-demo-runbook.xlsx (runbook with timing and slide cueing), NDA-ack.pdf (acknowledgement stub).

Notes: calendar hold created (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123ledgerquest). HubSpot deal linked for next-step: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/LQ-2028-PR-412.
